title: Cross-file inline edit list never disposed; handleListEndOfLifetime not fired
body:
## Summary

When the user accepts an inline edit whose target is a different document, the producing `InlineSuggestionList` is never disposed. As a consequence, the extension-host `InlineCompletionItemProvider.handleListEndOfLifetime` callback never fires for cross-file inline edits, and any end-of-life telemetry the extension sends from that callback is silently dropped.

This was caught while investigating missing `provideInlineEdit` telemetry for cross-file NES in the Copilot Chat extension.

title: Only surface "sort imports" and "remove unused imports" when TS client is running/useTsgo is not active
body:
See also https://github.com/microsoft/typescript-go/issues/1724

We want the TypeScript native preview extension to contribute commands for "sort imports" and "remove unused imports". Unfortunately, even when the `js/ts...useTsgo` setting is on, the built-in extension still makes the two commands available.

Ideally, we would have our extension register the same command, but double-registering a command name causes errors at runtime. So instead, each extension needs to defer to the other.

title: Chronicle: SQLite store is unreliable on SSH-Remote workspaces
body:
## Problem

The chronicle local store uses SQLite for persistence. On SSH-Remote workspaces (Linux), SQLite encounters cascading failures due to network filesystems not providing the POSIX locking guarantees that SQLite requires.

The failure pattern is:
1. Initial locking protocol errors or disk I/O errors
2. Escalates to database disk image is malformed
3. Then file is not a database (corruption is now permanent)
4. All subsequent flush operations fail until the database file is deleted
